page_sections.title: Built Through the REST API
page_sections.subtitle: Three Flexible Content layouts, one POST request.

page_sections.heading: Why This Matters
page_sections.content:
ACF accepts a page_sections array on create when the field group has Show in REST enabled and its location rules match this post type.

Each row is identified by its acf_fc_layout key.
